# Joy Braiding

> Professional hair braiding in Duluth, Georgia (Gwinnett County, Atlanta metro).

## Contact

- Phone / text: (605) 585-4899
- Website: https://joybraiding.com/

## Services and prices

- Box Braids — $180
- Knotless Braids — $200
- Cornrows — $70
- Twists — $200

Hours: Monday–Saturday, 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM (closed Sundays).

To book, call or text (605) 585-4899. Walk-in availability may vary; calling ahead is recommended.
